Language.String: SDK not loaded. Click Load SDK.

String.id: SDK 尚未加载，请选择动态库后点击“加载并检查”

Language.String: SDK not loaded. Choose a library, then click Load SDK.

String.id: 选择与本机架构匹配的 libsovkit

Language.String: Choose libsovkit for this system architecture

String.id: 选择空目录或已有 DevTools 目录（不使用 Nearvia 数据）

Language.String: Choose an empty or existing DevTools directory (not Nearvia data)

String.id: 明确授权保存接收文件的目录

Language.String: Choose the directory authorized to receive files

String.id: 正在停止 SDK、提交数据…
SovKit SDK 接入文档（随包原文）

Language.String: SovKit SDK integration guide (original supplied document)

String.id: 请求队列已满，请等待当前操作完成

Language.String: Request queue is full. Wait for the current operation.
. Check the request, authorization and target.
Invalid JSON. The SDK was not called.

String.id: SDK 尚未安全停止。请保留窗口，检查响应后重试停止。

Language.String: The SDK has not stopped safely. Keep this window open, check the response and retry Stop.

String.id: 导出操作名、状态码、耗时；不含请求、消息、身份、路径或密码

Language.String: Export operation names, codes and timing (no requests, messages, identities, paths or passwords)

String.id: 输入 JSON 对象；响应 code=0 不一定表示异步业务已完成。详细合同见随包 SDK 接入文档。

Language.String: Enter a JSON object. code=0 does not necessarily mean an asynchronous operation has completed. See the supplied SDK integration guide.

String.id: 这是 SDK 帧接口，不是系统蓝牙扫描器。桌面工具未接入 GATT 驱动；可手动注入/提取帧验证协议。

Language.String: SDK frame interface, not a system Bluetooth scanner. No GATT driver is connected; manually inject or extract frames to verify the protocol.

String.id: 检查全部动态符号和二进制加解密往返，不创建身份或发送网络流量。

Language.String: Check all dynamic symbols and binary encryption round trips without creating an identity or sending network traffic.

String.id: 显示运行库的 sdkVersion、ABI 和能力；不能从头文件推断运行库功能。

Language.String: Show sdkVersion, ABI and capabilities reported by the loaded library. The header alone cannot establish runtime capabilities.

String.id: 先启动测试身份；发现是候选，不会自动建立信任。可添加 listenPort 固定会话端口。

Language.String: Start a test identity first. Discovery provides candidates without establishing trust. Set listenPort for a fixed session port.

String.id: 填入 discovery_list 返回的 address / pairingPort。双方须分别检查安全码并确认。

Language.String: Enter address / pairingPort from discovery_list. Both peers must check the safety code and confirm.

String.id: 先查看 pairing_status 并与对方核对安全码，双方分别确认。

Language.String: Check pairing_status and compare the safety code with the other peer. Both peers must confirm.

String.id: 从 relationship_list 复制关系 ID。返回成功是入队，送达看事件和消息状态。

Language.String: Copy a relationship ID from relationship_list. Success means queued; check events and message status for delivery.

String.id: 选择文件按钮填入路径；指定关系 ID。局域网传文件，BLE 不支持文件传输。

Language.String: Use Choose file to fill in paths and specify a relationship ID. Files transfer over LAN; BLE does not support file transfers.

String.id: 先查看 transfer_list，再明确接受或拒绝；接受时选择接收目录。

Language.String: Check transfer_list, then explicitly accept or reject. Choose a destination directory when accepting.

String.id: 从挂起返回时触发恢复；accepted 只表示入队，继续查看 session_list 和消息回执。

Language.String: Trigger recovery when returning from suspension. accepted means queued; keep checking session_list and message receipts.

String.id: 读取会话草稿与修订号；保存 draft 时 action=save，expectedRevision 必须等于读取的 draftRevision。返回 requestId 后轮询 store_result_v1。

Language.String: Read the conversation draft and revision. To save draft, set action=save and expectedRevision to the returned draftRevision. Poll store_result_v1 with requestId.

String.id: 省略 messageId 会删除该关系全部已结算的本地消息；不删除对方副本或接收文件。

Language.String: Omitting messageId removes all settled local messages for this relationship. Peer copies and received files are retained.

String.id: 需要持久化测试身份打开 SQLCipher。返回 requestId 后用 store_result_v1 查询实际完成状态。kind 支持 message / transfer。

Language.String: Requires a persistent test identity with SQLCipher open. Query completion with store_result_v1 using requestId. kind supports message / transfer.

String.id: 填入提交响应中的 requestId（整数或十进制字符串）；未完成为 -10004，完成后检查 data.status。结果成功取出后即消费。

Language.String: Enter requestId from the submission response (integer or decimal string). -10004 means pending; check data.status when complete. Successfully retrieved results are consumed.

String.id: 先填写独立日志目录的绝对路径。日志是脱敏明文，不是密码库内容；role 使用 helper。

Language.String: Enter an absolute path to a separate log directory. Logs are redacted plain text, not vault contents. Use role=helper.

String.id: 请求模板为 DevTools 调试示例；SDK 接口语义以 SovKit 随包接入文档为准。

Language.String: Templates are DevTools debugging examples. SDK semantics are defined by the integration guide supplied by SovKit.

String.id: 检查能力 → 启动独立身份 → 发现与配对 → 收发验证 → 导出诊断

Language.String: Check SDK → Start identity → Discover & pair → Send & receive → Export

String.id: 搜索 API / 中文功能
事件自动轮询 · 只在内存保留最近记录

Language.String: Events polled automatically · Recent records kept in memory
